scores.notes: Pseudo-text on the station notice board by the door and on the station-master's ledger (left); Holmes at the right window is a recognisable Jeremy Brett-style screen likeness. Unpainted paper along the right edge and bottom corners (accepted).
Villagers on the hillside, one raising a hand to the golden sky, lit windows at right and a mounted Roman soldier on the road; no lettering, painted to every edge.
Job with staff on the ash heap looking up into a dust whirlwind and lightning-lit cloud; no figure in the cloud, no lettering, full-bleed.
Moses with staff on the shore stretching his hand as the sea splits to a stony path under wind-borne radiance; no figure in the light, edges painted.
Disciples bailing and rowing in a swamped boat at night with Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern; hands and faces sound, no lettering.
Image is a diptych: a hard vertical seam at about x=657 joins a separate city/bronze-sea view (left) to the Hezekiah-at-the-doorway panel (right).
Teacups and sugar bowl on the table carry letter-like marks (e.g. 'CUY', 'VUV' shapes) and plates have glyph squiggles; otherwise the drowsy tea-party pause with dozing Dormouse reads correctly.
Daniel with lifted hands beneath two flaming wheels in fiery cloud, ziggurat city on the horizon; no figure within the fire.
Young man in a linen tunic lifting his face to light from upper right before Jerusalem's walls, weary men resting against the wall and a dropped jar; anatomy and edges fine.
A painted artist-style signature sits in the bottom-right corner of the floor; Alice raising the bottle by the glass table with key and small garden door otherwise matches.
The bottle's tag carries legible 'DRINK ME' lettering (centre); hall, lamps, glass table with key and tiny door are all correct.
Elderly man on a woven mat with a kneeling woman and family gathered by tents and mud-brick huts at dusk; ground squiggles are not glyphs, edges painted.

The chariot column and three calm foot soldiers advance toward the viewer and fan out onto the near shore, reading as leaving the seabed rather than pressing into the sea; no Israelites visible on the far shore.
Young man in a tunic looking up into radiance from upper right by Jerusalem's wall, three weary men seated against it and a toppled jar; no faults found.
Disciples in the night storm rouse Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern, one gripping his shoulder, others at the mast; hands checked and sound.
David in the wadi with staff, stone and shepherd's bag faces armoured Goliath, a shield bearer and soldiers on the slope; the sling itself is not clearly shown but the scene reads.
Card courtiers at right carry 'A' and '7' corner indices (numerals/letters); Alice, Queen, floating Cat head, flamingo and hedgehogs otherwise match.
Ezekiel with raised arm holding a blank tablet among scattered bones; the watercolour vignettes into white paper at the top corners and sides (accepted).
Samuel pours oil from a horn on the kneeling young David with Jesse, sons and elders around a stone room, light shaft from above; anatomy sound, no lettering.

Disciples leave the boat toward the coal fire with fish and bread; a long-haired, centre-parted figure in the right-hand group of four reads like a conventional Jesus who was not selected, but could be a disciple. Sky fades to white paper at top (accepted).
In the drinking crowd (lower right) a dark-haired man's head emerges from a donkey's neck/withers, merging human and animal bodies; Moses mid-strike with Aaron in breastplate otherwise matches.
Peter leaps from the boat in his cloak while the beloved disciple points to Jesus standing by the coal fire on shore; top edges fade to white paper (accepted).
The unrolled papyrus on the table at bottom right shows lines of faint script, though the scene asked for unmarked rolls; Paul with bronze mirror and believers otherwise match.
Job with staff on the ash heap beneath a dust whirlwind and lightning cloud, broken pottery around; white paper shows at the top corners and edges (accepted).
The adder appears twice: once on the bell-pull at the ventilator (top left) and again on the floor (bottom left), contradicting itself; left edge is unpainted paper (accepted).
Radiance breaking through dark cloud over rippling deep waters with no figure, land or props; edges fully painted.
